definitions.ask: Should one run batch Google event fetches across the requested days?
definitions.why: The common case (today plus tomorrow) becomes one events call per calendar total

choices.label: One events call per calendar per contiguous day run, partitioned per day in bob
One events call per calendar per day; only version/account/calendars setup is shared

definitions.ask: Should multi-day JSON print one wrapper document instead of one line per day?
definitions.why: Every gcal JSON surface today is a single document; single-day output stays byte-identical

choices.label: One document with a days array holding the unchanged per-day report objects
One per-day report object per line as each day completes

definitions.ask: When one day fails mid-run, should the remaining days stop?
definitions.why: Post-fetch day failures are rare and usually global; reruns are idempotent

choices.label: Stop at the first failing day; completed days stay written; exit with that error code
Sync the remaining days, report every failure, exit non-zero
